c = [0] * 35
number = m
position = 0
is_possible = True

while number > 0:
    c[position] += number % w
    if c[position] == w:
        c[position] = 0
        c[position + 1] += 1
    if c[position] > 1:
        if c[position] == w - 1:
            c[position + 1] += 1
        else:
            is_possible = False
            break
    number //= w
    position += 1

print("YES" if is_possible else "NO")
